title: Chuyên đề thực tế (thực tập giữa khóa)
duration: 60 hours of practical training, 105 hours of self-study

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze the economic environment's impact on the development process of organizations at both macro and micro levels.
Master the overall analysis framework and synthesize issues that govern development processes.
Select and use models, analytical tools, and planning methods to manage development issues effectively.
Communicate effectively with stakeholders, present problems through written reports and presentations.
Identify, gather information, analyze, and solve problems systematically.
Develop, implement, monitor, and evaluate policies, strategies, plans, and projects.
Recognize ethical responsibilities in work, group responsibility, social responsibility, and professional ethics.
Think critically, listen actively, and engage in reflective thinking.
Possess the ability to learn independently, accumulate knowledge and experience to advance further.
